about_the_game:
Discover Alone or Together

Puzzle Parasite is a physics‑driven puzzle adventure set on an alien planet. It offers several ways to play:

  • Solo Campaign: Play as an Operative exploring mysterious ruins while your two crew mates chat and banter from orbit.

  • Co‑Op Mode: Team up with a friend to tackle the single player campaign, perfect for players who enjoy solving challenges together at their own pace.

  • Co‑Op Campaign: Unique challenging levels requiring teamwork and coordination.

Challenging Physics Puzzles

The core gameplay revolves around manipulating energy cores, light constructs and gravity devices to navigate through alien puzzles. As you progress, levels introduce new mechanics and deepen the mystery. Each new challenge builds on what you’ve learned, gradually revealing that these structures are not there just to test you.

Characters You’ll Remember

Follow Trent, an enthusiastic rookie, and Delilah, a dry‑humored professional, as they keep you company on your journey into the planet. Explore and uncover the secrets of this alien place, and discover the fate of your crew and yourself.

Key Features

  • A single-player campaign with the main story, also playable in co-op.

  • Dedicated co-op levels requiring two players to work together.

  • Physics‑based puzzles that use gravity manipulation, light‑bridge devices and core‑merging to overcome intricate environmental challenges.

  • A planet filled with enormous underground structures, each designed to test you in different ways.

  • Puzzles that progress as you progress, with levels continuously introducing new mechanics and adding new challenges.

  • A story and a mystery that you uncover in this alien place, while your crew Trent and Delilah follow you on the journey through the planet.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel I5 8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel I5 10500 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2080 8GB / Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Journey into alien ruins for a story‑rich, physics‑driven puzzle adventure or share the fun in co‑op mode. Solve mysterious puzzle physics challenges and see how deep the rabbit hole goes.
